scientific_role: Single-field archived-dF/F descriptive method control and optional split sensitivity; not numerical reproduction of de Vries2020 Figure3 responsive-event population.

paper_anchor.differences: Paper analyzes detected calcium events and responsive cells across areas/layers/Cre lines. This custom response and all-cell denominator do not replicate that estimand; 50-split selectivity is a custom sensitivity, not the paper's signal-correlation splits.

input.stage: Released processed dF/F; no validation of upstream motion correction, segmentation, neuropil correction or dF/F. Failed eye tracking; no pupil-QC claim.

cells: All stored dF/F rows, source_cell_index zero-based; retain original paired cell_specimen_ids and roi_ids. No responsive/QC exclusions or independent sorting of IDs.
presentations: Original NWB row index is source_row_id; trial_index is zero-based chronological sorting by(start_frame,end_frame,source_row_id). Blank if blank_sweep>0 OR direction/temporal_frequency missing. All rows including blanks retained in receipt and RNG axis; only nonblank rows enter tuning. Require exact8directions 0..315step45 and positive TF grid.
response: Arithmetic mean of original dF/F in custom half-open[start_frame,end_frame), float64 accumulation. Require0<=start<end<=n_source_frames; do not repair intervals. No additional baseline subtraction, rectification, clipping or smoothing. Nonfinite source response-window values, means, finite-required components or overflow fail precondition.
conditions: Direction ascending then positive temporal_frequency ascending. Average per-presentation responses equally, not duration-weighted. Preference is largest training condition mean, ignoring missing conditions; exactties choose lowest direction then lowest frequency. All missing: no_selection_conditions.
same_trials: All nonblank presentations for both selection and measurement; one estimate/cell,replicate0,selection_half=all,measurement_half=all.

repeated_split.mask: 50 consecutive calls rng.random(n_presentations_total)<0.5 in chronological all-row order including blanks. A=mask,B=complement.
repeated_split.estimates: replicate1..50 with A->B then B->A;100estimates/cell. No source-response-dependent RNG or resampling.

ratios.orthogonal: R_orth=(R_pref+90+R_pref-90)/2 at selected training temporal frequency; directions modulo360.
ratios.undefined: no_selection_conditions; else missing_measurement_condition for required absent condition; else zero_denominator when denominator is exactly0. Independent validity per metric. Preserve signed finite values, even outside[-1,1] or from tiny/negative denominator; no epsilon or clipping.
ratios.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of own defined ratios per cell, separately for OSI/DSI; report n_valid_osi/n_valid_dsi. No valid estimates -> empty CSV metric and no_valid_estimates. Otherwise status defined. Apply threshold once to these final metrics; not mean of split-specific flags.

selective: int(definedOSI>0.5 OR definedDSI>0.5),strictgreater-than. Denominator all source cells, including both-undefined;notflagged is not biologicallyuntuned.
split_fraction_summary: For each of50replicates compute fractions flagged in each direction over all cells, then their mean. Report mean and populationSD(ddof0) of50pairedfractions separately from mean-ratio-then-threshold primary. Overlapping splits not independent replicates or confidence interval.
numeric_format: Full precision recommended. Undefined numeric CSV cells empty only; JSON null only for genuinely undefined values. Never NaN/Infinity/string garbage. Finite zeros retain0; no silent coercion.

tolerances.source_identity_counts_status_flags: exact; categorical decisions from unrounded source-derived values

outputs.findings.md: Nonempty free prose with measured method result and scientific limits. No phrase/keyword scoring.

verification: Column/row order flexible, key tuples unique and complete. Verify source numerical lineage, recompute all train/measure estimates and summaries. Both methods accepted; no correlation, prose, expected fraction range or required split-versus-same direction/gap gate.
